newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Archer Daniels EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Archer Daniels EPS view cut.

text.p: -- NatWest Securities said it cut its fiscal year 1997 earnings estimate on Archer Daniels Midland Co to $1.16 a share from $1.26 a share.
-- Cut the fiscal year 1998 estimate to $1.45 a share from $1.61 a share.
-- Said the margin outlook for 1997 high fructose corn syrup (HFCS) processing "continues to deteriorate."
-- Said HFCS is Archer Daniel's most profitable business sector.

-- "We continue to caution investors regarding investment in these shares until the earnings weakness caused by excess capacity is more fully reflected in consensus earnings estimates," analyst David Nelson said in the report.
-- Shares dropped 1/4 to 20-5/8 in heavy trading.
